confirmedFindings.title: Missing monotonic fencing token allows split-brain mutations during leader lease transition
confirmedFindings.body: Performing state mutations without monotonic fencing token verification permits split-brain writes when a leader lease expires during long execution or GC pauses.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Issue an incrementing fencing token upon lease acquisition and validate the token on all downstream database writes.
